description: Work out when to leave for Seatac (SEA) for a departing flight, the seatac.co departure planner's rule: be at the terminal 2 hours before a domestic or 3 hours before an international departure (SEA's advice), minus Seatac's stored typical drive from the starting point. Returns the terminal-arrival target, the pickup time, a prefilled ride booking link, and how long before departure to leave from each place we have a drive time for.

departure_datetime.description: Scheduled departure, ISO 8601; Seattle local time when no offset, e.g. 2026-11-02T08:15.

drive_minutes.description: Optional drive time in minutes (5-240) when starting elsewhere; overrides the stored time.

from.description: Starting point with a stored drive time.

international.description: true for an international flight (3-hour rule); default false (2 hours).

pickup_address.description: Optional exact pickup address, prefilled in the booking link.

name: plan_airport_departure
title: When to leave for SEA
